title: Backdoor Sentinel: Detecting and Detoxifying Backdoors in Diffusion Models via Temporal Noise Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2602.01765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have been widely deployed in AIGC services, but their reliance on opaque training data exposes them to backdoor attacks. In practical auditing scenarios, auditors are typically unable to access model parameters due to intellectual property protection, making white-box or query-intensive detection impractical. After detection, existing detoxification approaches are trapped in a dilemma between detoxification effectiveness and generation quality for service providers. translated_title: 后门哨兵：通过时间噪声一致性检测和净化扩散模型中的后门
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已广泛部署于AIGC服务中，但其对不透明训练数据的依赖使其容易受到后门攻击。在实际审计场景中，由于知识产权保护，审计人员通常无法访问模型参数，使得白盒或查询密集型检测不可行。检测后，现有的净化方法在服务提供者的净化效果和生成质量之间陷入两难困境。我们揭示了时间噪声一致性（TNC），一种此前未报道的现象，即后门激活会破坏特定时间片段内相邻扩散时间步之间噪声预测的一致性，而干净输入则保持稳定。基于此发现，我们提出TNC-Defense，一种用于灰盒后门检测和模型修复的闭环框架。具体而言，TNC-Detect（供审计人员使用）利用推理阶段的相邻噪声一致性进行检测。
tldr: 该论文首次发现时间噪声一致性（TNC）现象，并提出TNC-Defense闭环框架，实现灰盒场景下的高效后门检测与模型净化，兼顾检测实用性和生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper first reveals Temporal Noise Consistency (TNC) phenomenon and proposes TNC-Defense, a closed-loop framework for efficient gray-box backdoor detection and model detoxification, balancing practicality and generation quality.
